english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something full of danger or likely to cause harm.
This is the all-purpose choice for something risky or dangerous.
This is the all-purpose choice for something dangerous or involving risk.
Use this when emphasizing that something presents danger or an immediate hazard rather than merely lacking safety.
Use this for a treacherous situation, route, or object when the main idea is that it is dangerous.
Use this instead of 恐怖 when the dreadful aspect is that something is dangerous or risky.
Use this when the focus is that the idea or action involves danger or is risky, rather than on the person's boldness.
Use this when a nasty situation, route, accident, or illness is dangerous, including a critical condition.
